notes: Elo constants are builder B's frozen fit (tuned on 2005-2019 log-loss): ratings are walk-forward, the constants are not.
Serve/return constants (half-life, ridges) are B's tuned values; the fits themselves are walk-forward.
Retirements, walkovers and defaults are excluded from scoring.
Bookmaker probabilities are closing prices de-vigged multiplicatively.

model = Elo + serve/return + game-share Elo + market rating (mrating.py: learnt from earlier matches' closing prices and results, never the match's own); model_fund = the same blend without the market rating.
